items: 【Applicable Size】This waterproof patio sofa cover fits standard 3-seater outdoor wicker, teak, and metal sofas (up to 80"W x 38"D x 35"H). For the best fit, measure your sofa and choose a cover 1-3 inches larger

【No Tears】This outdoor sofa cover is made of high-density heavy duty polyester fabric with double stitching. It ensures exceptional quality against tears and fading and keeps your chair looking new. It’s even tough enough to resist cat scratches

【Excellent Waterproof】Our covers made of durable fabric with surface hydrophobic PVC coat, so water just bead up & roll off the outdoor couch covers. For zero water leakage, the cover pressure-glued seam tape, All of these ensure excellent waterproofing

【UV Resistant】Our patio sofa cover features a double-layer PU waterproof and UPF50+ UV protection coating. This premium material blocks 99.99% of UV rays, keeping your outdoor chairs protected from rain, dirt, and sunlight all season long

【Windproof Design】Our patio furniture covers feature 4 sturdy windproof click-close buckles and 2 adjustable drawstrings at the bottom for a tight and secure fit, ensuring the cover remains in place in rain, snow, frost, and other adverse weather

【Moisture Resistance】These Outdoor furniture covers waterproof feature 2 side air vents to effectively reduce condensation, as well as upgraded reinforced stitching to prevent water seepage. They keep your patio couch dry even on heavy rainy days

【Convenient to Use】Our stackable waterproof patio covers features handles on both sides for easy installation and handling and is space-saving. The smooth surface of the patio couch cover allows for easy cleaning with a quick wipe-down

【After-sales & Replacement】MR. COVER offer a 5-year replacement guarantee and 24-hour friendly customer support, any problem with our outdoor furniture covers please contact us. Note:Do not wash in the washing machine to avoid discoloration or damage
